name: Liberty Citations: Tools and Commands Reference
description: Reference for every tool of the liberty-citations toolkit: the thirteen MCP tools of the liberty server (liberty_status, search_quotes, get_passage, stoky_search, stoky_post, stoky_sync, library_setup, misescz_sync, youtube_find, youtube_catalog, transcribe, job_status, add_source) with arguments, defaults, what they return and the matching CLI command; CLI-only commands (fetch, index, docs, stoky authors, ankap sync, raw FTS5 search); search syntax (sources, all versus any terms, quoted phrases, Czech stemming); the background-job lifecycle; transcription engines and models; the web-path URL patterns for claude.ai; the Chrome tools used for login-bound steps; data locations and environment variables; and a worked call sequence from search to a citation. Use it when unsure which tool or argument does a job.
content:
# Liberty Citations: tools and commands

What each tool of the liberty-citations toolkit does, how to call it and what comes back. The toolkit is the `liberty` MCP server (stdio) and the `liberty` CLI over one local SQLite FTS5 index: about 26 free libertarian books, all of stoky.urza.cz (about 3,500 posts since 2015), Urza's ankap.urza.cz texts, optional mises.cz articles and every video you transcribe.

## Reaching it
- MCP: `scripts/install.sh` registers the server as `liberty` (user scope); restart Claude Code afterwards. The tools are then `mcp__liberty__<tool>`. Manual registration: `claude mcp add liberty -s user -- <venv>/bin/python ~/.claude/skills/liberty-citations/scripts/mcp_server.py`.
- CLI: `liberty <command>` or `python3 <skill>/scripts/liberty.py <command>`; `liberty --json <command>` for machine-readable output.
- Neither (claude.ai, another agent): the web path below.

## MCP tools
| Tool | Arguments (default) | Returns | CLI |
|---|---|---|---|
| `liberty_status` | none | installed modules and binaries, CUDA, which speech-to-text keys are set (true or false only), the auto engine order, corpus size per source, library download state, the last five jobs | `liberty doctor`, `liberty status` |
| `search_quotes` | `query`; `sources` (list); `author`; `lang`; `limit` (8); `any_terms` (false) | `mode` (all or any) and `hits`: chunk_id, source, author, title, year, lang, locator, url, date, snippet, citation, score | `liberty search "…" --source book --author Rothbard --limit 10` |
| `get_passage` | `chunk_id`; `context` (1) | `citation`, source, author, title, year, lang, url, `license`, and `parts` (chunk_id, locator, text, is_hit) | `liberty passage 12345 --context 1` |
| `stoky_search` | `query`; `author`; `since`, `until` (YYYY-MM-DD); `limit` (10) | the best hit per post: title, author, date, url, snippet, citation | `liberty stoky search "…" --since 2020-01-01` |
| `stoky_post` | `url_or_id`; `include_comments` (true) | a live fetch of the post and its `comment_list` (id, parent, author, time, text) | `liberty stoky post 3816` |
| `stoky_sync` | `full` (false) | a job: new months, and the last two months again | `liberty stoky sync` |
| `library_setup` | none | a job of about 10 minutes: download and index the free library, crawl ankap.urza.cz and Stoky, fetch the video catalogue | `liberty setup` |
| `misescz_sync` | `limit` (300) | a job: Czech articles from mises.cz, resumable, about one article a second | `liberty misescz sync --limit 300` |
| `youtube_find` | `query`; `limit` (10) | `videos` ranked by title, description and the Stoky post that announced them (each with a `match` score), `transcript_hits` inside transcribed videos, `catalog_size`, `catalog_fetched` | `liberty yt find "…"` |
| `youtube_catalog` | `refresh` (false) | every channel video: id, title, duration, date, transcribed | `liberty yt catalog --refresh` |
| `transcribe` | `src` (URL or file); `engine` (auto); `model`; `language` (cs); `clip` ("MM:SS-MM:SS"); `title`; `author` | a job; the transcript goes to `$LIBERTY_HOME/transcripts/` (.txt with [mm:ss] markers, .srt, .json) and into the index | `liberty transcribe URL --clip 12:00-15:00` |
| `job_status` | `job_id` | status (running, done or error), result, error, the log tail | `liberty job ID` |
| `add_source` | `target` (URL, or a local PDF, EPUB, HTML or TXT path); `author`; `title`; `year`; `lang` (cs) | the indexed document | `liberty add <url-or-file> --author … --title …` |

Jobs: a tool that starts one returns at once with an `id`. Poll `job_status(job_id=<id>)` every 30 to 60 seconds and report progress in one line. Never start the same job again to "retry": read its log tail first. `liberty job` with no id lists recent jobs.

## CLI only
- `liberty fetch [ids]` and `liberty index [ids] [--force]`: books from `manifest.json`, after editing it.
- `liberty docs [--source …]`: what is indexed.
- `liberty stoky authors`: Stoky authors with their pages.
- `liberty stoky sync --full` or `--since YYYY-MM`; `liberty ankap sync`; `liberty misescz sync --start N --end N`.
- `liberty search … --any` (any word) or `--raw` (FTS5 syntax).
- `liberty transcribe … --date YYYY-MM-DD --no-index`.

## Searching well
- `sources` values: `book`, `stoky`, `ankap`, `mises.cz`, `youtube`, `media`, `web`.
- All words must match by default. `any_terms=true` widens; `mode` in the result says which was used, and the search falls back to any when all gives too few hits.
- "Quoted phrases" match exactly. The index stems Czech: drogy, drogám and drogová all match.
- Query in the source's language: English for the books (narcotics, drugs, prohibition, victimless, vice, opium, black market), Czech for Stoky, ankap, mises.cz and transcripts. Run two to four variants.

## Transcription
- `engine="auto"` tries, in order: local faster-whisper on an NVIDIA GPU, YouTube's Czech captions, the Groq Whisper API (free tier, `GROQ_API_KEY`), faster-whisper on the CPU, OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Explicit engines: `captions`, `faster-whisper`, `groq`, `openai`, `custom`.
- Models: `large-v3-turbo` by default on a GPU; `large-v3` when verifying a quote window; `small` on a CPU, for finding a moment only. `base` and `small` garble Czech: never quote from them or from raw captions.
- OpenAI and ElevenLabs Scribe bill the user: ask first. "Wispr Flow" is a dictation app, not a batch transcriber.

## Web path (no toolkit)
- Stoky: month archive with full texts `https://stoky.urza.cz/archiv/YYYY-MM`; a post `https://stoky.urza.cz/texty/<id>`; topic search with WebSearch `site:stoky.urza.cz <terms>`; the submission form `https://stoky.urza.cz/psani/`.
- Urza's texts: `https://ankap.urza.cz/<topic>/` (for example `/drogy/`, `/princip-neagrese/`, `/zlocin-a-trest/`); the index is on the home page.
- Mises Institute books: `https://mises.org/online-book/<slug>`, one chapter at a time (it answers 403 to bursts); PDFs on `cdn.mises.org`.
- mises.cz: `https://www.mises.cz/clanky/x-<id>.aspx`, or WebSearch `site:mises.cz <terms>`.
- Videos: `https://www.youtube.com/@kanalsvobodnehopristavu`; #ne_poslušnosti videos are linked from `https://stoky.urza.cz/nep/`. YouTube blocks cloud servers, so nothing is downloaded from claude.ai.
- The Facebook group `https://www.facebook.com/groups/ForumSvobodnehoPristavu/` works only through Chrome.

## Chrome (steps behind a login)
`navigate`, `get_page_text`, `read_page`, `find`, `form_input` and `computer` (screenshot, scroll, click) in the user's own logged-in Chrome, used by `liberty-stoky-publish`, `liberty-fsp-forum-read` and `liberty-fsp-forum-post`. The user logs in; never type, store or ask for a password.

## Data and settings
- `$LIBERTY_HOME` (default `~/.local/share/liberty-citations`): `corpus.sqlite`, `books/`, `transcripts/`, `media/` (safe to delete), `models/`, `youtube/catalog.json`, `jobs/`, `drafts/`.
- Environment: `GROQ_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `LIBERTY_STT_BASE_URL` with `LIBERTY_STT_API_KEY` and `LIBERTY_STT_MODEL`, `LIBERTY_WHISPER_MODEL`, `LIBERTY_YTDLP_COOKIES_BROWSER` or `LIBERTY_YTDLP_COOKIES`. Report a key as set or not set; never print its value.

## Worked call sequence
1. `search_quotes(query="vices crimes", sources=["book"], author="Spooner", limit=5)`: pick a hit and note its `chunk_id`.
2. `get_passage(chunk_id=<id>, context=1)`: read the parts around the one with `is_hit`, and copy the quote from there.
3. Cite it with `citation`, the locator and the URL, in the block from `liberty-citation-rules`.

## Prompts of the pack
`liberty-router` picks one of: `liberty-find-citations`, `liberty-verify-quote`, `liberty-write-czech-text`, `liberty-dabing-srt`, `liberty-stoky-match-posts`, `liberty-stoky-post-from-idea`, `liberty-stoky-publish`, `liberty-fsp-forum-read`, `liberty-fsp-forum-post`, `liberty-ksp-video-find-transcribe`, `liberty-ksp-video-quote`, `liberty-toolkit-ops`. `liberty-citation-rules` applies to all of them.
